name: Ask your invoices: chat with your e-invoice archive using a local AI model (numbers computed by code)

parameters.content:
## Ask your invoices — chat with your e-invoice archive, numbers computed by code

Companion to *Process incoming e-invoices (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X)*: it reads the **e_invoices** Data Table that workflow fills.

Ask in plain German or English — *„Was haben wir im Oktober an Hetzner gezahlt?“*, *"Which invoices are overdue?"*, *„Welche Rechnungen müssen geprüft werden?“*, *"Top suppliers this year"*.

### Why the numbers are right
Small local models are bad at arithmetic. So the model never adds anything up:
1. **Understand question** turns the question into a filter (supplier, period, due dates, status, amounts) — relative dates like *last month* are resolved to exact dates.
2. **Compute answer** filters the table and sums net, VAT and gross per currency in plain JavaScript.
3. **Write answer** gets only those computed facts and writes one or two sentences.
4. **Reply** adds the exact figures and the matching invoices as a table — plus the filter that was applied, so a misunderstood question is visible at once.

Runs fully local with **Ollama** (e.g. Llama 3.1 8B or Qwen 3 8B); any other chat model works too.

### Set up
1. Import and run the incoming e-invoice workflow first (it creates and fills `e_invoices`).
2. Point both *AI model* nodes to your Ollama server or another chat model.
3. Open the chat (*Chat* node → Open chat) and ask.

Note: the table knows due dates, not payments — *overdue* means the due date has passed.

Built by Denis Shokhirev · DennisCraft AI Studio, Freiburg — gerdennisai.com

attributes.name: intent
attributes.description: One of: list, total, by_seller, overdue, count, problems. total = sums only; by_seller = grouped by supplier; overdue = due date already passed; problems = invoices marked for review

attributes.name: seller
attributes.description: Part of the supplier name if the question names one, otherwise empty

attributes.name: search
attributes.description: Other search word (invoice number, file name) if mentioned, otherwise empty

attributes.name: dateFrom
attributes.description: First invoice date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

attributes.name: dateTo
attributes.description: Last invoice date to include, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

attributes.name: dueFrom
attributes.description: Earliest due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

attributes.name: dueTo
attributes.description: Latest due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: de if the question is German, otherwise en

options.systemPromptTemplate: =You turn a question about received supplier invoices into a search filter. Today is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}. Resolve relative periods yourself: 'last month', 'im Oktober', 'dieses Quartal', 'next 7 days' become exact YYYY-MM-DD dates. 'What is due soon' means dueFrom = today and dueTo = today + 14 days. Leave a field empty when the question does not ask for it. Never invent supplier names.
